title: 第十六章  收割
content_zh:
啪啪啪！随着声音一落，琼霄缓缓的走了出来。“呵呵，范大宗主，你没想到吧，我还停留在此处，你们的战斗真是精彩呢，我差点就忍不住冲出去和你们并肩战斗了，”琼霄声音有些奇怪味道。

    紧盯着琼霄，虚弱范森双眼微眯起来说道：“琼霄，今天算我万剑宗栽了，杜狼的仇，我万剑宗不报了，你从他身上得到的好处，我万剑宗也不再索取，这件事就此揭过！怎样？”

    “呵呵，范宗主说得对，我也不喜欢有人总是在背后不停地追杀我，这事就此了结了吧！”

    “还是琼霄老弟大量！”范森脸上露出了笑容说道。“嘿嘿，这事可不能就这么算了，来日方长，我就不信你能跑的掉？”范森眼底下闪过一丝阴狠的精光。

    “范宗主说笑了，我所说的了结，就是永远的了结这件事，要想永远了结这件事就只有一个方式，那就是不是你们死就是我亡！你说对么？范大宗主，”琼霄戏虐道。

    “你！咳咳！”范森一激动一口鲜血又喷了出来，“琼霄，你若敢动我万剑宗一分丝毫，我万剑宗与你不死不休！”

    “呵呵，想当初杜狼也是这么说的，不过他已经和天狼团消失了。我这人有个习惯，我不喜欢放过总是在背后对我造成威胁的人，你怎么说我都行，说我是个小人也可以，说我是个屠夫也罢，只要与我为敌，那就是必死无疑，希望你记住我今世的脸庞，来生记得不要再与我为敌！”琼霄露出了凶狠的目光，手持着重剑朝着范森一伙人缓缓走来。

    “你！”范森望着一步步走来的琼霄，心中越来越恐惧。

    琼霄缓步走到一位**境强者身旁，二话不说，重剑扬起，旋即便是如同打球一般，一剑拍出。“咔嚓！”重剑轰击在这名**境强者身上，这人顿时倒飞而出，狠狠撞在了一棵大树，一阵骨骼断裂的清脆声响，在周围回荡着，令得范森等人心头都是一寒，在这琼霄一剑下，那人就算不死，即便伤好了，也是得落个残废。一剑废掉一名万剑宗的强者，琼霄脚步不停，脸色冷漠的立刻转身，走向另外一名在战斗中存活下来的万剑宗强者，这名万剑宗强者见到琼霄的举动，眼中顿时涌现一抹恐惧，想拿起武器对抗，却拿不动，有心却无力而为，只能眼睁睁的看着前面的人一剑挥下，嘭的一声，人便是再度如皮球般的倒射而出，最后重重的落在十数米之外的地面上，不知死活。又是一剑解决一个，琼霄脸庞的冷漠越加浓郁，又是转身，走向下一个受伤的人。

    范森的心脏，随着每一次琼霄重剑的挥动，都是会狠狠的颤一下，他没想到琼霄的手段居然那么狠辣，琼霄是真的打算要废了他整个万剑宗啊，万剑宗倾巢而出，居然会落的这么个下场。

    怪只能怪万剑宗追杀琼霄，琼霄与万剑已经处于不死不休的那种局面这事，既然如此，他自然不会留给万剑宗什么力量来找他复仇，对于敌人的仁慈就是对自己的残忍。对于这种事琼霄不会有丝毫的心慈手软，只有真正的令得万剑宗失去实力，方才能断绝自己的一些后顾之忧。

    此事，也怪不得琼霄，要怪，就怪率万剑宗率先对他出现杀心吧...

    “嘭！”重剑再度狠狠的甩在最后一名万剑宗强者身上，然后琼霄也不理会此人是死是活，缓缓转身，目光望向了不远处还在挣扎挣扎着站起身来的人影，这人正是范森。
content_en:
Bang bang bang!As soon as the voice fell, Qiong Xiao slowly walked out."Haha, Sect Master Fan, you didn't expect that I'm still here. Your battle was so exciting that I almost couldn't help but rush out and fight alongside you," Qiong Xiao's voice sounded strange.

Staring at Qiong Xiao, the weak Fan Sen narrowed his eyes slightly and said: "Qiong Xiao, today I, Wan Jian Sect, have been defeated. I, Wan Jian Sect, will not avenge Du Lang. I, Wan Jian Sect, will no longer ask for the benefits you got from him. This matter has been revealed! How about it?"

"Haha, Sect Master Fan is right, I don't like people always chasing me behind my back, so let's end this matter!"

"Brother Qiong Xiao still has a lot!" Fan Sen said with a smile on his face."Hey, we can't just let this matter go. The days are long, so I don't believe you can run away?" Fan Sen's eyes flashed with a sinister glint.

"Sect Master Fan is joking. What I mean by ending is to end this matter forever. There is only one way to end this matter forever, and that is either you die or I die! Are you right? Master Fan," Qiong Xiao said jokingly.

"You! Ahem!" Fan Sen got excited and spat out a mouthful of blood, "Qiong Xiao, if you dare to touch my Wan Jian Sect even a little bit, I, my Wan Jian Sect, will fight you to the death!"

"Haha, I think Du Lang said the same thing at the beginning, but he has disappeared with the Sirius Group. I have a habit. I don't like to let go of people who always threaten me from behind. You can say whatever you want about me. You can say that I am a villain.I am a butcher, and as long as you are my enemy, you will definitely die.I hope you will remember my face in this life and remember not to be my enemy in the next life!" Qiong Xiao showed a fierce look and walked slowly towards Fan Sen and his group with a heavy sword in hand.

"You!" Fan Sen looked at Qiong Xiao walking towards him step by step, feeling more and more frightened in his heart.

Qiong Xiao walked slowly to the side of a strong man in the physical realm. Without saying a word, he raised his heavy sword and struck out with the sword like a ball."Crack!" The heavy sword struck the strong man in the ** realm, and the man immediately flew backwards and hit a big tree hard. A crisp sound of broken bones echoed around, making Fan Sen and others feel a chill in their hearts. Under Qiong Xiao's sword, even if the man did not die, even if he recovered from his injuries, he would still be crippled.A sword destroyed a strong man from the Wan Jian Sect. Qiong Xiao kept walking, and immediately turned around with a cold face, walking towards another strong man from the Wan Jian Sect who survived the battle. When this strong man from the Wan Jian Sect saw Qiong Xiao's actions, a touch of fear suddenly appeared in his eyes, thinkingHe picked up a weapon to fight, but couldn't lift it. He had the intention but was unable to do anything. He could only watch the person in front of him swing his sword. With a bang, the person was shot backwards like a ball again, and finally landed heavily on the ground more than ten meters away. He didn't know whether he was dead or alive.Another one was killed with one sword, and the indifference on Qiong Xiao's face became more intense. He turned around again and walked towards the next injured person.

Fan Sen's heart trembled violently every time Qiong Xiao's heavy sword was swung. He didn't expect that Qiong Xiao's methods were so ruthless. Qiong Xiao really planned to destroy his entire Wan Jian Sect. Wan Jian Sect came out in full force, but they would end up like this.

The blame can only be blamed on Wan Jian Zong for chasing Qiong Xiao. Qiong Xiao and Wan Jian are already in a life-and-death situation. In this case, he will naturally not leave Wan Jian Zong with any strength to seek revenge on him. Being kind to the enemy is cruel to oneself.Qiong Xiao will not be merciful in this kind of thing. Only by truly making Wanjian Sect lose its strength can he cut off some of his worries.

Qiong Xiao can't be blamed for this. If not, let's blame Wan Jian Sect for being the first to show murderous intentions towards him...

"Bang!" The heavy sword was thrown hard at the last Wanjian Sect strongman again. Then Qiong Xiao didn't care whether the person was dead or alive. He slowly turned around and looked at the figure who was still struggling to stand up not far away. This person was Fan Sen.
